for name in ["Zone_F1_Z01_Electric_Power_Sensor", "Zone_F1_Z04_Electric_Power_Sensor"]:
    i = ttl.find(name)
    # find the statement block (triple starting with bldg:...)
    # search backwards for "bldg:" start
    start = ttl.rfind("bldg:", 0, i)
    end = ttl.find(" .", i)
    print("====", name)
    print(ttl[start:end])
    print()
